_note: Example criteria registry. Keys under 'countries' are jurisdiction codes of your choosing. Every entry here is EXAMPLE ONLY - check your jurisdiction: national or local rules take precedence and may differ in metric, period definition, measurement position and penalties. Supported noise criterion types: absolute_limit, absolute_limit_with_background_adjustment, increment_over_background (see engine/criteria.py).

EXAMPLE.country_name: Example based on international guidance (example only - check your jurisdiction)

noise.limit_logic: example only - check your jurisdiction. IFC guideline values for residential, institutional and educational receptors (day 07:00-22:00, night 22:00-07:00). The IFC guideline also allows at most a 3 dB increase over background, which this example does not encode.
noise.source: IFC (2007), Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) General Guidelines, section 1.7 Noise, Table 1.7.1
noise._informative: example only - check your jurisdiction. WHO (2018) Environmental Noise Guidelines for the European Region, section 3.4: wind turbine noise Lden below 45 dB (conditional recommendation); no night-time recommendation is made. This engine computes downwind LAeq, not Lden, so the WHO value is listed for information only.

shadow_flicker.limit_logic: example only - check your jurisdiction. Astronomical worst case at most 30 h/year and at most 30 min/day; where a shutdown system is installed, actual (real) shadow flicker is limited to 8 h/year.
shadow_flicker.source: LAI (2020), Hinweise zur Ermittlung und Beurteilung der optischen Immissionen von Windkraftanlagen (WKA-Schattenwurfhinweise), Stand 23.01.2020
